description:
A lawyer and a prosecutor who are arguing before a trial, the two were once lovers. On the first day of the trial, when their careers are on the line, they are suddenly locked in a sex room… Yoo Hyun-Woo, who does not want to have sex with Han Jun-Seo again, is disgusted, but… 

*“This is a case that all the media is paying attention to. If we don’t show up, it’s over for both of us.”*

Yoo Hyun-Woo feels ashamed of himself for eventually getting crushed in bed. It has always been like this. The inferiority complex he feels towards Han Jun-Seo is what eventually led them to break up. “You still like this position.” And a new mission from the sex room arrives in front of them.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)
